authorization: current user overnight model-research goal; delegated bounded explore root
warmstart_selection: minimum stop H among existing residue_mean fold0 seed1701 LRs; never selected on evaluation
selection: LR per mode by stop group_macro_H; evaluation is exposed development only
scope: Historical T to vertex-p, frozen identical cache and groups; no new C or AFDB training

mechanisms.uniform_scratch: zero final scorer produces uniform weights exactly at initialization
mechanisms.mean_continue: same warm checkpoint and added budget; controls extra supervised training
mechanisms.uniform_warm: known-good residue transform/readout retained; zero scorer, new AdamW state
mechanisms.gated_warm: mean+tanh(alpha)*(random_attention-mean), alpha initialized zero; scorer NOT zeroed to avoid dead gate

stopping: finish eight fits or bounded failure; freeze results and report candidates for separate fold/seed replication
